dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Hi, Nam. Thanks for applying to volunteer with us.
dialogue.reading: ˈhaɪ, ˈnɑːm. ˈθæŋks fər əˈplaɪɪŋ tə ˌvɑːlənˈtɪr wɪð ˈʌs.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thank you for meeting me. I've been reading about your organization for weeks.
dialogue.reading: ˈθæŋk juː fər ˈmiːtɪŋ miː. aɪv bɪn ˈriːdɪŋ əˈbaʊt jʊr ˌɔːrɡənəˈzeɪʃən fər ˈwiːks.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Great. We're a small non-profit, and we teach English in village schools.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡreɪt. wɪr ə ˈsmɔːl ˌnɑːnˈprɑːfɪt, ənd wiː ˈtiːtʃ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪn ˈvɪlɪdʒ ˌskuːlz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I love that idea. How long have you been doing this?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈlʌv ˈðæt aɪˈdiːə. ˈhaʊ ˈlɔːŋ hæv juː bɪn ˈduːɪŋ ˈðɪs?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I've been running the organization for six years. So, have you volunteered before?
dialogue.reading: aɪv bɪn ˈrʌnɪŋ ði ˌɔːrɡənəˈzeɪʃən fər ˈsɪks ˈjɪrz. soʊ, hæv juː ˌvɑːlənˈtɪrd bɪˈfɔːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. I've been volunteering at a charity in Bangkok since June.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. aɪv bɪn ˌvɑːlənˈtɪrɪŋ ət ə ˈtʃærəti ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk sɪns ˈdʒuːn.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What have you been doing there?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt hæv juː bɪn ˈduːɪŋ ˈðɛr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I've been helping them with donations for poor families.
dialogue.reading: aɪv bɪn ˈhɛlpɪŋ ðɛm wɪð doʊˈneɪʃənz fər ˈpʊr ˈfæməliz.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Mostly clothes and books. Some companies donate money, too.
dialogue.reading: ˈmoʊstli ˈkloʊðz ənd ˈbʊks. sʌm ˈkʌmpəniz ˈdoʊneɪt ˈmʌni, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's great experience. Why do you want to join us?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈɡreɪt ɪkˈspɪriəns. ˈwaɪ duː juː ˈwɑːnt tə ˈdʒɔɪn ʌs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I've been studying English for years, and now I want to share it with children who need it.
dialogue.reading: aɪv bɪn ˈstʌdiɪŋ ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ fər ˈjɪrz, ənd ˈnaʊ aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈʃɛr ɪt wɪð ˈtʃɪldrən huː ˈniːd ɪt.
